# AllSoft.asia

> AllSoft.asia is an AI-powered software platform providing ChatHub online chat, AI toolbox, and software development services. All products run on Cloudflare's global edge network, accessible directly in China without VPN.

## Products

### ChatHub
Real-time online chat platform built on Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects. Features: group chat, anonymous chat, random matching, online status, WeChat Pay integration. Free to start, no registration required.

### AI Toolbox (Beta)
Collection of AI capabilities including writing, translation, summarization, and code assistance. China-accessible, no VPN required. Currently in beta testing.

## Technology

- Hosting: Cloudflare Pages (free tier)
- Edge computing: Cloudflare Workers
- Real-time: WebSocket + Durable Objects
- Code: GitHub
- SSL/CDN: Cloudflare (automatic)
- No servers, no VPN required, China-accessible
